baslik: 1st Anniversary Gift for Husband, Personalized Aquarius Aquarius Zodiac Couple Print with Names and Date, Paper Anniversary Card
aciklama:
A personalized 1st anniversary gift for your husband, made from your two zodiac signs, Aquarius and Aquarius. Your names and your special date are added to your own shared symbol, for married couples and for couples celebrating one year together.

Every AstroLoveArt design merges two zodiac signs into one shared symbol. This listing is for the Aquarius and Aquarius symbol shown in the photos.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Choose your style and your format.
2. In the personalization box, write the first name (left), the second name (right) and your special date (your wedding day or the day you met). Example: Emma, James, 14 June 2025.
3. Heading: "Paper Anniversary" for married couples or "Our First Year" for couples who are dating. Tell us which one you prefer. The card always says "Happy First Anniversary".
4. Optional: a short line of your own, up to 20 characters, to replace "Year One".

FREE PREVIEW BEFORE YOU ORDER
Would you like to see your design first? Message us your names, your date and your chosen style, and we will send you a free preview.

AFTER YOU ORDER
We send your final preview in Etsy Messages within 24 hours. As soon as you approve it, we prepare your file or your print.

STYLES
Starlit, Timeless, First Page, Layers, Botanical.

FORMATS
- Printable card 5x7: a single-sided flat card as a digital file, to print at home or at a print shop.
- Digital file: an 8x10 inch, 300 dpi JPG for your own printing.
- Print: printed on matte paper and shipped by our production partner. Unframed; it fits standard frames.

PLEASE NOTE
The gold, relief and paper layer looks are printed visual effects. Prints are flat matte prints, with no foil, no raised layers and no cut paper pieces. Colors can look slightly different on screens and on paper.

WHY PAPER
Paper is the traditional gift for the first wedding anniversary. A print of your own two signs, your names and your date is a paper gift made only for the two of you.

ABOUT OUR DESIGNS
We use AI tools in our design process, and we check every file by hand before it is delivered or printed.

A personalized 1st wedding anniversary gift made from your two zodiac signs, Aries and Capricorn. Your names and your special date are added to your own shared symbol, for married couples and for couples celebrating one year together.

Every AstroLoveArt design merges two zodiac signs into one shared symbol. This listing is for the Aries and Capricorn symbol shown in the photos.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Choose your style and your format.
2. In the personalization box, write the Aries name, the Capricorn name and your special date (your wedding day or the day you met). Example: Aries: Emma, Capricorn: James, 14 June 2025.
3. Heading: "Paper Anniversary" for married couples or "Our First Year" for couples who are dating. Tell us which one you prefer. The card always says "Happy First Anniversary".
4. Optional: a short line of your own, up to 20 characters, to replace "Year One".

FREE PREVIEW BEFORE YOU ORDER
Would you like to see your design first? Message us your names, your date and your chosen style, and we will send you a free preview.

AFTER YOU ORDER
We send your final preview in Etsy Messages within 24 hours. As soon as you approve it, we prepare your file or your print.

STYLES
Starlit, Timeless, First Page, Layers, Botanical.

FORMATS
- Printable card 5x7: a single-sided flat card as a digital file, to print at home or at a print shop.
- Digital file: an 8x10 inch, 300 dpi JPG for your own printing.
- Print: printed on matte paper and shipped by our production partner. Unframed; it fits standard frames.

PLEASE NOTE
The gold, relief and paper layer looks are printed visual effects. Prints are flat matte prints, with no foil, no raised layers and no cut paper pieces. Colors can look slightly different on screens and on paper.

WHY PAPER
Paper is the traditional gift for the first wedding anniversary. A print of your own two signs, your names and your date is a paper gift made only for the two of you.

ABOUT OUR DESIGNS
We use AI tools in our design process, and we check every file by hand before it is delivered or printed.

A personalized 1 year anniversary gift for your boyfriend, made from your two zodiac signs, Cancer and Pisces. Your names and your special date are added to your own shared symbol, for married couples and for couples celebrating one year together.

Every AstroLoveArt design merges two zodiac signs into one shared symbol. This listing is for the Cancer and Pisces symbol shown in the photos.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Choose your style and your format.
2. In the personalization box, write the Cancer name, the Pisces name and your special date (your wedding day or the day you met). Example: Cancer: Emma, Pisces: James, 14 June 2025.
3. Heading: "Paper Anniversary" for married couples or "Our First Year" for couples who are dating. Tell us which one you prefer. The card always says "Happy First Anniversary".
4. Optional: a short line of your own, up to 20 characters, to replace "Year One".

FREE PREVIEW BEFORE YOU ORDER
Would you like to see your design first? Message us your names, your date and your chosen style, and we will send you a free preview.

AFTER YOU ORDER
We send your final preview in Etsy Messages within 24 hours. As soon as you approve it, we prepare your file or your print.

STYLES
Starlit, Timeless, First Page, Layers, Botanical.

FORMATS
- Printable card 5x7: a single-sided flat card as a digital file, to print at home or at a print shop.
- Digital file: an 8x10 inch, 300 dpi JPG for your own printing.
- Print: printed on matte paper and shipped by our production partner. Unframed; it fits standard frames.

PLEASE NOTE
The gold, relief and paper layer looks are printed visual effects. Prints are flat matte prints, with no foil, no raised layers and no cut paper pieces. Colors can look slightly different on screens and on paper.

WHY PAPER
Paper is the traditional gift for the first wedding anniversary. A print of your own two signs, your names and your date is a paper gift made only for the two of you.

We use AI tools in our design process, and we check every file by hand before it is delivered or printed.

A personalized 1st wedding anniversary gift made from your two zodiac signs, Leo and Virgo. Your names and your special date are added to your own shared symbol, for married couples and for couples celebrating one year together.

Every AstroLoveArt design merges two zodiac signs into one shared symbol. This listing is for the Leo and Virgo symbol shown in the photos.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Choose your style and your format.
2. In the personalization box, write the Leo name, the Virgo name and your special date (your wedding day or the day you met). Example: Leo: Emma, Virgo: James, 14 June 2025.
3. Heading: "Paper Anniversary" for married couples or "Our First Year" for couples who are dating. Tell us which one you prefer. The card always says "Happy First Anniversary".
4. Optional: a short line of your own, up to 20 characters, to replace "Year One".

FREE PREVIEW BEFORE YOU ORDER
Would you like to see your design first? Message us your names, your date and your chosen style, and we will send you a free preview.

AFTER YOU ORDER
We send your final preview in Etsy Messages within 24 hours. As soon as you approve it, we prepare your file or your print.

STYLES
Starlit, Timeless, First Page, Layers, Botanical.

FORMATS
- Printable card 5x7: a single-sided flat card as a digital file, to print at home or at a print shop.
- Digital file: an 8x10 inch, 300 dpi JPG for your own printing.
- Print: printed on matte paper and shipped by our production partner. Unframed; it fits standard frames.

PLEASE NOTE
The gold, relief and paper layer looks are printed visual effects. Prints are flat matte prints, with no foil, no raised layers and no cut paper pieces. Colors can look slightly different on screens and on paper.

WHY PAPER
Paper is the traditional gift for the first wedding anniversary. A print of your own two signs, your names and your date is a paper gift made only for the two of you.

ABOUT OUR DESIGNS
We use AI tools in our design process, and we check every file by hand before it is delivered or printed.
